result.summary: Read-only production and source audit proves the inactive-display warning is a direct isReachable presentation bug, while today's untouched 95% Pending Review arose because trusted Watch correlation is dormant in Native and absent/unconfigured in the production Server path. PR celebration functionally passes; only larger local confetti is requested.

root_causes: Build 84 treats every WCSession isReachable=false transition as phoneUnavailable and renders OFFLINE without an actionable failure or staleness threshold.
HealthKitBatchBuilder constructs the trusted workout normalizer in its explicit disabled state, so the Watch metadata never becomes a physiqueOSSessionId.
Production Server b47663b does not contain the trusted exact-correlation implementation; the implementation-bearing composition also defaults its trusted source allowlist empty.
The generic matcher therefore correctly created a 95% logger_session_window candidate and Pending Review; enabling heuristic auto-confirm is not an acceptable workaround.
decisions_required: After implementation, tests and fresh independent review, Founder authorization will be required before any Server deployment, production trusted-source allowlist/config activation, or mutation of today's Pending Review.
recommended_next_step: Create isolated Build 85 Native/Server worktrees from the exact Build 84 authorities, implement the proven narrow corrections, test them, prepare the exact guarded activation/repair dry runs, obtain fresh independent review, then publish and stop at the Founder authorization gate.
